messages:
kevin_fin: Quick check — GCP reseller invoice R-9902 shows a negative proration for promo credit that we didn't authorize. Partner says they requested a one-time promo but we only approved on the 5th, not retro to month start. Can we confirm who approved?
ana_ops: @kevin_fin I see a note in the partner request thread: 'apply promo retroactive start Apr 1' from partner rep. But approval audit shows approver id 'ops_auto' at Apr 4 02:12 — that seems like an automation rule applied it.
tom_aws: automation rule 'promo-auto-apply' was retired last quarter. If it's still running in one region, it's a config drift. Check ops infra.
billing-bot: Automated check: promo-auto-apply triggered for partner rr-gcp-55 on 2026-04-04. Promo tx lines: PR-4422 credited $980 for Apr 1-30.
kevin_fin: ok we need to revoke the retro credit or ask partner to accept it as good will. What's the financial impact?
ana_ops: $980 credit, but if we revoke it'll require an invoice reissue. Partner is small; might be better to absorb. Need mgmt sign-off.
tom_aws: ops will disable any stray automation in eu-west-1 and patch rule so 'promo-auto-apply' doesn't run. Also will add a guard to require manual operator approval for retro credits.
kevin_fin: i'll loop in finance leadership. if we keep the credit, create GL code PROMO-WAIVE-2026-Q2 and mark as marketing expense. If we reclaim, we need TO-INV adjustment.
billing-bot: Reminder: submit change request to infra tag #infra-config for disablement by EOD.
ana_ops: submitted change: CHG-2026-778. ETA 24h.
kevin_fin: thanks team. We'll decide by EOD.
